text:
Aisha Khan: Morning — quick heads-up about onboarding & the weekend coverage. I'm pairing with Priya this week for on-call shadowing. Priya will be the daytime shadow (09:00–17:00) and I'll officially hand active pager duties to her at 17:00 on Thursday. I'm still reachable for escalation until EOD Friday, but I won't be primary for paging after the handover.

Lee Chen: noted. There's a known gap Friday 22:00–02:00 UTC where we currently have no volunteer. I can take it if nobody objects, but will need a quick runbook refresher first.

Priya Patel: happy to shadow and take daytime pager. Aisha — can we do a 45m run-through of the main inference runbooks today at 16:30? I want to watch a live paging flow as well. :coffee:

Aisha Khan: yes — 16:30 works. Agenda: primary/secondary responsibilities, how to interpret the latency dashboards in Console, the KV-cache eviction patterns to look for, escalation steps (SEV→oncall lead→SRE rotation). I'll post the checklist in thread.

DevOncallBot: [ALERT P2] 3319998895 — inference-service: elevated 5xx rate in us-west-2 (35% over baseline). Paging primary: Aisha Khan. Incident channel created: #inc-3319998895-inference.

Aisha Khan: grabbing it now. Priya, stick with me in the console; I'll show you quick triage. Initial checks: replicas healthy? yes/no, recent config rollouts? check, prefix cache hit ratio.

Marco Silva: if this becomes a P1 (customer impact on completion), call in SRE lead and open the postmortem template early. We should also check the autoscaling event logs for any OOMs.

Aisha Khan: running quick health checks —
```bash
# quick health probe and logs
curl -sS -H "x-team: inference" https://infra-api.internal/us-west-2/inference/health || true
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --selector=app=inference | tail -n +2
```

Aisha Khan: output looks like some pods in CrashLoopBackOff on node g4dn-09 (possible kernel driver flake). Escalating to eng-sre. I'm adding the node to transient-drain so new pods schedule elsewhere.

Lee Chen: I can handle the transient-drain steps if you want me to run the cordon/drain. Also will validate that dedup cache isn't thrashing (seen that before cause of bad tokenizer binary).

Aisha Khan: please do the cordon/drain; steps in runbook section 2b. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx (see "Node flake" subsection). Key snippets: restart inference-manager, check KV cache hit ratio, and if 5xx persists roll back last quantization tweak.

Nina Gomez: quick note on handoffs — please add a one-line status to the oncall-handover doc when you hand over active pager: https://redwood.internal/oncall/handovers. Fields: current-primary, shadow, last-alert, next-cover. It helps the weekend oncall.

Priya Patel: copied. I'll be in the console at 16:30 for the run-through and will update the handover doc at 17:00 when we flip the pager. Also tagging @Lee to confirm weekend slot.

Lee Chen: confirmed I can take Fri 22:00–02:00 UTC. Priya/Aisha — for the runbook refresher please highlight the quick rollback command and how to cut traffic to fallback model:
```bash
# rollback to previous model variant
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference --to-version v1.14.3 --confirm
# cut model routing to fallback
redwoodctl routes set --service inference --model fallback-quant --percent 100
```

Priya Patel: perfect, thanks. Two quick Qs for the run-through: 1) when do we escalate to the Dedicated standby (phone list)? 2) where's the checklist for customer comms (who drafts first message)?

Aisha Khan: answers — 1) escalate to Dedicated standby if customers report >20% failed completions for 10+ minutes or SLA breach is imminent (see runbook threshold table). 2) Customer comms template lives in the incident docs repo: https://redwood.internal/incidents/templates/customer-comms.md — we usually have PM or support draft, oncall approves & posts.

Marco Silva: FYI — I'll update the PagerDuty schedule after 17:00 to reflect the handover so the rotation UI doesn't show Priya as still secondary for an old slot.

Aisha Khan: thanks all. After we finish the live triage I'll mark the thread with a short summary and set the handover doc. Priya — see you at 16:30 in the console. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: on it. Will be ready to take the pager at 17:00 and update the handover doc. Appreciate the pairing.

DevOncallBot: [RESOLVE] 3319998895 — incident mitigated: nodes redistributed, crashlooping pods restarted, 5xx rate falling back to baseline. Ticket: INC-5942.

Aisha Khan: resolved — documenting steps and will link postmortem draft to the incident channel. Last note: Priya, when you take active pager please post a quick "I am primary" message to #eng-oncall and update the oncall-handover doc so the weekend team can see the change.

Priya Patel: will do right after handover. Thanks everyone for quick responses.
